objects.name: Analytic 2134
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset setting a wireless interface to monitor mode via iwconfig or netlink calls, from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with documented wireless diagnostics. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): execve of wireless configuration utility setting monitor mode on Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Linux asset by User Identifier (UID) not in authorized wireless admin UIDs

Hosts authorized to legitimately enable wireless capture for diagnostics.
